name: Wizard OS 0.3.94 — 0.3.93 with Wizard UX 96f111f0 -> 7991db03, Agent Service 1f78352d -> 9233c199 (fixes)
about: Latest 0.3.93 with Wizard UX 96f111f0 -> 7991db03, Agent Service 1f78352d -> 9233c199. Cut by the release train for merged Recommended fixes: humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#757 Recommended fix: Store can remove an installed app; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#758 Recommended fix: model picker stays clear of draft text; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#761 Recommended fix: the Welcome never switches skin on its own; picking sets only the skin; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#762 Recommended fix: model switch recovers when ChatGPT models briefly drop out; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#763 Recommended fix: a greyed model or stopped AI reading opens its app at Reconnect; humanitylabs-org/wizard-ux#764 Recommended fix: title-bar tools get search, QR and settings icons and an attention dot; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#281 Recommended fix: show and change which subscription the agent uses first; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#282 Recommended fix: an idle subscription's expired sign-in renews instead of blanking its usa; humanitylabs-org/wizard-agent-service#283 Recommended fix: Use first is not offered where stock Hermes cannot apply it; humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager#368 Recommended fix: keep an app behind an owner gateway on its Wizard path. Stable stays 0.3.90 until the installed upgrade test passes.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.
